definitions.title: Polar Coordinate System
definitions.latex: x = r\cos(\theta), \quad y = r\sin(\theta), \quad r^2 = x^2 + y^2, \quad \tan(\theta) = \frac{y}{x}
definitions.statement: A two-dimensional coordinate system in which each point P is determined by a radial distance r from the pole (origin) and an angle theta from the positive x-axis (polar axis). If r < 0, the point lies along the ray opposite to theta.
conditions: r in R, theta in R
definitions.explanation: Points in polar coordinates have non-unique representations: (r, theta) = (r, theta + 2k pi) = (-r, theta + (2k+1) pi).
definitions.keyTakeaway: Connects circular radius and rotation angle to Cartesian plane coordinates.
